items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: That was for the Jefferson City Buzzer, we used to play every year. That was with Tajama Garnier.

ctx.x: So did you pick up from the make up band?
That was for the Jefferson City Buzzer, we used to play every year. That was with Tajama Garnier. He was a trumpet player. That was with Tajama Garnier.
